description: The due-diligence report on one vault, cut to what an agent acts on: overallAssessment (published, conditional or withheld; publishedBand is null when withheld and partialBand is never the verdict), findings above the band, each risk dimension, capital and withdrawal bounds, metricStatus (each input current, indicative, stale, unavailable or not-read, with its times and expiry), completeness, warnings and agentRules. Follow agentRules when you answer: they say what must be quoted and what must not be said. PAID ($5 over x402, or inside a plan with due diligence). The digest names the whole issued document; verify it at /v1/reports/{digest}.
name: vault_due_diligence

agentRules.description: What your answer must and must not say. Follow them.

changesSincePrevious.description: Standard figures before and after against the previous report, each changed, below_threshold (moved, under the 1% materiality threshold), unchanged (within a dollar) or not_comparable, with a note that says the move, with both times and models.

completeness.description: Coverage by area, missing fields, currentDecisionStatus, nextCurrentInputExpiryAt, snapshot.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the whole issued document.

dimensions.description: Each risk dimension with its level and what set it.

highestFinding.description: The worst single risk read, level and label. The weighted result never cancels it.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

metricStatus.description: Per input: status, times, expiry, whether the result used it.

notAssessed.description: Risk areas this report did not assess, each with status not assessed, not tested or not established. Say them; the score’s input share does not cover them.

overallAssessment.description: status, publishedBand, publishedScore, partialBand, partialScore, reasonCode, reason, findingsAboveBand, inputsNotCurrent, judgedAt.

unattributedCapital.description: value (null unless measured), unit, status (measured, not_established or unreconciled_residual), differenceUsd, asOf. Never report null as zero.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

title: Due-diligence report for agents (paid)
